target_aura_gates.reason: 705291 is a native ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, op 12) on EffectSpellClassMask bit 22, +6 on Condemn 567539 effect 1; Condemn effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER (271) with EffectBasePoints -1 (0 without the passive), matching Chastise by EffectSpellClassMask (coa-dbc-viewer record --id 705291/567539/503141). The fixture sets the caster's Condemn on the target at its stack cap before every trial (set_aura with caster), without casting it: a Condemn cast would also grant Oath: Condemn 804922, whose effect 2 is a +30% damage modifier on Chastise (EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bit 128), and the caster does not know Condemn, so HandleCastSpellOpcode drops the cast (SpellHandler.cpp:461-485). The 0-stack arm learns Templar's Might and sets no Condemn, so it proves no bonus without Condemn on the target while the talent is held; the 1-stack arm is judged at +6% and the cap at +18%, so a flat bonus that ignores the stack count is alert.

triggers.fix_note: round5 fix: Check() case 680397 (AscensionTemplarEvents.cpp) did not filter event.GetTypeMask(), so a self-targeted heal fired it twice per heal - Unit::ProcSkillsAndAuras (Unit.cpp:7583-7591, Unit::TriggerAurasProcOnEvent, Unit.cpp:14280-14310) dispatches the same aura list once with the DONE-side type mask (healer) and once with the TAKEN-side type mask (healed target), and for a self-heal both dispatches reach the same player's own aura; a live probe (self-casting Benediction 578276) measured 546 casts of 680398 for 273 casts, exactly 2x. The fix adds (event.GetTypeMask() & DONE_HIT_PROC_FLAG_MASK), the same filter sibling id 705298 already carries, so only the DONE-side dispatch passes; an ally heal is unaffected (the ally's own TAKEN-side dispatch never scans the healer's aura list, a different unit). round8 fix: the scenario left the caster at full health, so every self-cast Benediction fully overhealed to GetEffectiveHeal()==0 and Check()'s `heal` bool was always false (measured 0 of 273); added caster_health_pct (the same fixture sibling 705298 already uses) to ensure an effective heal lands on each attempt

Treatment: Test Healing Power + 300 966472 (Effect[0] aura 135 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_DONE, EffectMiscValue[0] 127, EffectBasePoints[0] 299): 71.15 + 105 = 176.15 against 71.15, ratio 2.4758. Engine value (review m1): Amount(803159, 0) is CalcValue, int32 71; with +300 healing power 71 + 105 = 176; the class aura 887007 -20% truncates to int(56.8) = 56 and int(140.8) = 140: 140 / 56 = 2.5, the expected ratio. behaviours.name: Light's Chosen
behaviours.quote: and your spell penetration by
behaviours.expected_source: $s3 = 10 (301310 EffectBasePoints[2] 9, EffectDieSides[2] 1). Light's Chosen's effect 2 triggers 301369 (Effect[0] aura 123 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, EffectMiscValue[0] 126), whose amount AscensionTemplarAuras.cpp:68-70 sets to 10% of the caster's Intellect. Greatness 60234 (+300 Intellect) is set in both arms: Intellect 332 (clause 46), so the penetration is int32(33.2) = 33. The dummy is a level 60 creature: CoA.MonsterResistance (coa.conf.dist, PerLevel 1.0, PerPercent 5.0) gives it 60 holy resistance, an average resist of 60 / 5 / 100 = 12% (Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance, Unit.cpp:2582-2626), drawn in tenths by Unit::CalcAbsorbResist. With 33 penetration the dummy keeps 27, 5.4%: (1 - 0.054) / (1 - 0.12) = 1.075 for Zealotry 801450, a Holy hit with no spell-power term. A penetration that raised the resistance by 33 instead (93, 18.6%) reads 0.925. Zealotry needs an off-hand weapon (SPELL_ATTR3_REQUIRES_OFF_HAND_WEAPON): Ancient Bone Mace 30754 beside the one-hand main hand. The attack power fixture makes the weapon roll negligible beside the resist draw. Light's Chosen's spell power (effect 0) does not reach a weapon-damage hit and its crit rating (effect 1) is filtered out: only non-critical hits are compared.

behaviours.name: Scourgebane
behaviours.quote: This is guaranteed to critically strike against Undead enemies.
behaviours.source: AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp:120 (OnSpellCalculatedTarget): if (info->Id == 801832 && (target->GetCreatureType() == CREATURE_TYPE_UNDEAD || spell->GetScriptValue(806523))) hit.crit = true; - an unconditional hard override of the hit outcome for Scourgebane's own damage spell 801832 whenever the target's creature_template.type is CREATURE_TYPE_UNDEAD (6), independent of the player's own crit chance/rating. creature_template entry 1501 (Mindless Zombie) is type 6 (data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql); DUMMY_ENTRY 36 (Harvest Golem), used by every other Templar scenario including 92111's own proc_rate entry, is type 9 (Mechanical), so this entry needs its own target override rather than the shared dummy. A direct per-hit crit flag is needed because the override happens inside OnSpellCalculatedTarget's TargetInfo.crit at damage-calculation time, not through a SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE-style stat change: Player::SpellDoneCritChance/Unit::SpellTakenCritChance (the spell_taken_crit_chance metric already used for this exact clause shape on other classes, e.g. the chronomancer Wand of Time scenario) do not read this hook and would read the caster's ordinary crit chance regardless of target type. 100 auto-attack swings (Scourgebane's own 20% per-hit chance, $520007h, means an expected ~20 triggers) against the Undead target, counting spell_damage_count of 801832 split by the critical flag: every triggered hit landing on it must be critical (crit_label total == crit+noncrit total), or the clause is violated.

behaviours.name: Righteous Lunge
behaviours.quote: and granting an Oath
behaviours.source: AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp:155-165 (OnSpellCast, unconditional on spell->IsTriggered()==false): if (Family(info, 2, 1) || info->Id == 500689) { uint32 oath = Named(info, 801443) ? 804904 : Named(info, 801445) ? 804903 : Named(info, 804906) ? 804922 : 805332; GrantOath(player, oath); }. 570233 Righteous Lunge has SpellFamilyName 25 and SpellFamilyFlags[2] bit 0 set (confirmed via coa-dbc-viewer record), matching Family(info,2,1); sSpellMgr->GetFirstSpellInChain(570233) chains to root 801443 (extra_spells citation), selecting oath 804904 ("Oath: Righteous Lunge"). GrantOath (AscensionTemplar.cpp:163-175) casts the oath aura on the caster and the Oath Chain 704576, incrementing its stack by exactly 1 (capped at 10), unconditional on hit/miss since OnSpellCast fires regardless of the target roll.

behaviours.name: Righteous Upheaval
behaviours.quote: Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional damage for each consumed.
behaviours.source: 804904 (Oath: Righteous Lunge) carries two ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) effects keyed to SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (MiscValue 0) whose EffectSpellClassMask word 2 includes bit 128 (effect 0 mask 161, effect 2 mask 128; coa-dbc-viewer record), both matching 572027's own SpellFamilyFlags word 2 (128, Family(info,2,128) == AscensionTemplar::Breaker), so both register in Player::m_spellMods[SPELLMOD_DAMAGE] and both multiply in Player::ApplySpellMod's totalmul (Player.cpp:10539). Rather than hand-deriving BasePoints via Spell.dbc (4 and 29, which undercounts: SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue's DieSides==1 roll adds +1, not +0, giving actual registered mod values 5 and 30), this entry's 1.365 is the engine's own ground truth, read directly with the spell_modifier metric (base 1000, op 0) before and after fixturing 804904 to 1 stack: 1000 -> 1364.9998779296875 (round10/judging-work/diag, 2026-11-10). 1.05 * 1.30 = 1.365, confirming both mods and the +1 die-roll correction together, not a coincidence. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:9920) applies this same op unconditionally for a non-DOT effect onto the already-computed tmpDamage (what the 'before' formula read already measures), so the ratio is exact and caster-stat-independent. AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp:174 (Breaker(info) branch) calls ClearOaths(player) unconditionally on a 572027 cast (572027 is not Named(info,805409), the one exemption), consuming every held Oath aura including 804904. round10/judging-fix: 804922 (Oath: Condemn) also carries an ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effect 2, MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), EffectSpellClassMask word 2 bit 128 (coa-dbc-viewer record), the same family/op/mask 572027 itself matches, so the plural 'for each consumed' genuinely credits two distinct held Oath types, not a single id's amount reused for all five; but the two Oaths' ratios compound multiplicatively, not additively: ground-truthed live (round10/judging-fix-work/cmp1, 2026-11-10), 804904 alone read 800 -> 1091 (ratio 1.364), 804922 alone read 800 -> 1040 (ratio 1.30), both together read 800 -> 1419 (delta +619, matching 1091*1040/800 = 1419.4, not the naively additive 1091+1040-800 = 1331); other_oath_spell/behaviour_oath_consumption_verdict asserts the both-delta against this multiplicative product (after*other_alone/before), not a sum, plus that 804922's own aura_stacks also reads 0 after the cast.

behaviours.name: Chastise
behaviours.quote: Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional damage for each consumed.
behaviours.source: Same mechanism and the same ground-truthed 1.365 ratio as 572027's own oath_consumption entry (see its source note for the spell_modifier diagnostic and the +1 die-roll correction): 503141's SpellFamilyFlags word 2 is 128 (coa-dbc-viewer record), matching both of 804904's SPELLMOD_DAMAGE-keyed effects. ClearOaths(player) runs unconditionally on the Breaker(info) branch of a 503141 cast. round10/judging-fix: other_oath_spell 804922 (also SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, mask word 2 bit 128; see 572027's source note) proves the plural 'for each consumed' across two distinct Oaths, not just 804904's own amount; the two ratios compound multiplicatively, as ground-truthed on 572027 (see its own source note's live numbers), not additively.

behaviours.name: Benediction
behaviours.quote: Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional healing for each consumed.
behaviours.source: Same SpellMod mechanism and the same ground-truthed 1.365 ratio as 572027's own oath_consumption entry (see its source note), the healing side: Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone (Unit.cpp:10868) applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spellProto->Id, SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, heal) for a non-DOT heal, reading the same SPELLMOD_DAMAGE op list as damage. 578276's SpellFamilyFlags word 2 is 128, matching both of 804904's SPELLMOD_DAMAGE-keyed effects. Benediction's own healing effect is effect 1 (the class file's existing '578276 effect_value e1' labels for its headline clause); target is the caster (self-heal, matching the existing scenario convention 'target': 'self' used for this spell's other checks). round10/judging-fix: other_oath_spell 804922 (same SPELLMOD_DAMAGE/mask-128 match, read through the healing path too) proves the plural 'for each consumed' credits two distinct Oaths on the healing side as well; the ratios compound multiplicatively, as ground-truthed on 572027 (see its own source note's live numbers), not additively.

behaviours.name: Blade of Faith
behaviours.quote: Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional damage for each consumed.
behaviours.source: 803872 is a periodic-damage spell (Effect[0] 6 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA, EffectApplyAuraName[0] 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, EffectAmplitude[0] 3000; coa-dbc-viewer record), so Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone is called with damagetype DOT and applies SPELLMOD_DOT instead of SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (Unit.cpp:9920). Of the 5 Oath auras, only 804903 (Oath: Holy Cleave) carries a SPELLMOD_DOT entry (effect 2, ApplyAuraName 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 22 = SPELLMOD_DOT, EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 2048), matching 803872's own SpellFamilyFlags word 1 (2048); the other 4 Oaths' effect 2 is keyed to SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (misc 0), which this DOT path never consults, so they contribute 0 here even though 803872 also carries SpellFamilyFlags word 2 = 128. Rather than hand-deriving the raw Spell.dbc BasePoints (24, which undercounts: SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue's DieSides==1 roll adds +1, not +0), this entry's 25 is the engine's own ground truth, read directly with the spell_modifier metric (base 1000, op 22) before and after fixturing 804903 to 1 stack: 1000 -> 1025 exactly (round10/judging-work/diag, 2026-11-10). A SPELLMOD_FLAT op adds this value onto tmpDamage after every other scaling term (Player.cpp:10539's totalflat path), so the before/after delta is a fixed +25 regardless of caster stats. This entry is independent of the open dot-overshoot question (round10/questions-judging.md), which concerns 803872's own base periodic_total value, not this Oath delta. round10/judging-fix: other_oath_spell 804904 is deliberately one of the 'other 4' that this DOT path never consults (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE, not SPELLMOD_DOT), so holding it alongside 804903 must add exactly 0 to the flat delta (expected_both_delta collapses to the same +25) while still proving ClearOaths consumes 804904 too, not just the one Oath this metric happens to price.

behaviours.name: Reckoning
behaviours.quote: Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional damage for each consumed.
behaviours.source: 805421's own clause is proven via its max rank, 572741 (coa-dbc-viewer record: SpellFamilyFlags word 2 = 128, Effect[0] 2 SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE), the same castable spell the class file's existing 572741-labelled checks for this clause's own headline damage already use. Same SpellMod mechanism and the same ground-truthed 1.365 ratio as 572027's own oath_consumption entry (see its source note for the spell_modifier diagnostic). round10/judging-fix: other_oath_spell 804922 (same SPELLMOD_DAMAGE/mask-128 match as 572027's source note) proves the plural 'for each consumed' credits two distinct Oaths for this spell too; the ratios compound multiplicatively, as ground-truthed on 572027 (see its own source note's live numbers), not additively.

behaviours.name: Righteous Tempest
behaviours.quote: Consumes your Oaths, dealing additional damage for each consumed.
behaviours.source: 805409 is exempt from AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp:174's unconditional ClearOaths on a Breaker cast (!Named(info, 805409)), so it never clears Oaths at cast time unlike every other oath_consumption entry above. AscensionTemplarAuras.cpp's aura_ascension_templar_lifecycle::Calculate (id == 805409, index == 0) instead sums max(0, GetAuraEffect(oath, EFFECT_2)->GetAmount()) over {804904, 804922, 804924, 805332} into GetAura()->SetScriptValue(805409, bonus), read back by AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp's OnSpellCalculatedTarget as factor *= 1.0f + scriptValue/100.0f on every RighteousTempest() hit (805410, 570200-570205). The Oaths are cleared only by ::Remove's own Named(GetSpellInfo(), 805409) branch, which runs AfterEffectRemove for AURA_EFFECT_HANDLE_REAL with no remove-mode filter, so a natural expiry fires it exactly like a manual dispel. coa-dbc-viewer record confirms all four summed Oaths' own EFFECT_2 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with EffectBasePoints[2] == 29 and EffectDieSides[2] == 1 (SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue's die roll adds +1, giving a live aura_amount of 30 for each, confirmed by reading it directly rather than hand-deriving it); 804904 and 804922 (two different Oath types) are fixtured together so the scenario proves the sum is genuinely additive across distinct Oaths, not a single id's own amount reused. 805409's own DurationIndex is 27 (SpellDuration.dbc: 3000 ms), so settle_ms 500 reads the baked-in bonus and the still-held Oaths well before expiry, and expire_margin_ms 1500 on top of the remaining 2500 ms reliably outlasts the natural removal.

behaviours.name: Disciplined Blows
behaviours.quote: Only occurs once every 0.5 sec.
behaviours.source: AscensionTemplarEvents.cpp:74-76 (aura_ascension_templar_event::Check, case 680397): fires only when !State(player).cooldowns.HasTimeUntilEvent(680397). Proc() (line 157-159) unconditionally schedules State(player).cooldowns.ScheduleEvent(680397, 500ms) on every fire, a per-player world-tick timer distinct from the engine's own spell_proc.Cooldown column (the spell_proc row this aura carries, rev_20260909_04_templar_completion.sql line 10-11, has no Cooldown value, confirming the gate is this scripted timer, not Aura::IsProcOnCooldown). Casting 578276 (Benediction) at self three times, spaced 250 ms then 750 ms apart (total 1000 ms, 500 ms past the window), must show no new 680398 cast between the first two and exactly one between the last two.

behaviours.name: Untainted
behaviours.quote: Can only occur every 15 sec.
behaviours.source: AscensionTemplarEvents.cpp:77-79 (Check, case 705298): fires only when !State(player).cooldowns.HasTimeUntilEvent(705298). Proc() (line 161-163) schedules ScheduleEvent(705298, 15s) on every fire, the same per-player timer as 680397. Reuses the trigger shape (cast 803792 at an ally, caster_health_pct 50, restore_charges) already proven by this aura's existing triggers.py proc_rate entry. Casting 803792 three times, spaced 7500 ms then 8000 ms apart (total 15500 ms, 500 ms past the window), must show no new 705299 cast between the first two and exactly one between the last two. 803792's own Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_CHARGE (coa-dbc-viewer record) with RangeMin 5 yd/RangeMax 30 yd (SpellRange.dbc id 54): a first attempt without a per-attempt relocate measured two real SPELL_FAILED_TOO_CLOSE (128) cast failures (round10/judging-work/step9/run1, stamp 20261110-021200) because the charge itself pulls the caster to melee range of the ally on every successful cast, leaving it inside the 5 yd minimum for the next attempt; `icd_gate_attempt_fixtures` now relocates the caster +10 yd (CHARGE_OFFSET_YD) before every attempt, not once, matching `triggers.py`'s own `closes_distance`-gated relocate fixture for this same charge effect.

behaviours.name: Scarlet Champion
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once per sec.
behaviours.source: AscensionTemplarEvents.cpp:91-92 (Check, case 805415): fires only when !State(player).cooldowns.HasTimeUntilEvent(805415). Proc() (line 178-179) schedules ScheduleEvent(805415, 1s) on every fire, the same per-player timer mechanism. Casting 807268 (Argent Blade, forced to crit) three times, spaced 500 ms then 1000 ms apart (total 1500 ms, 500 ms past the window), must show no new 805416 cast between the first two and exactly one between the last two.

behaviours.name: Sacred Defense
behaviours.quote: Can only occur once per sec.
behaviours.source: AscensionTemplarEvents.cpp:128-137 (aura_ascension_templar_event::Proc, case 705306): fires only when !State(player).cooldowns.HasTimeUntilEvent(705306), schedules ScheduleEvent(705306, 1s) on every fire, the same per-player world-tick timer every other internal_cooldown_gate entry on this class measures (the spell_proc row this aura carries, rev_20260909_04_templar_completion.sql line 21, has no Cooldown column). The trigger is incoming Physical damage, not a cast by the caster, so the existing triggers.py taken_hit fixture (16827, Claw (Pet), the entry's own prior status/reason documented round8's measurement: 212 landed hits against the reference Templar's armor read exactly 6, 7 or 8 damage, and Proc() computes Copy(player, event.GetActor(), 707720, uint64(damage) * 15 / 100) -- AscensionTemplar.cpp's Copy() skips the cast entirely when the truncated amount is 0, which 15% of 6 always is) cannot drive this gate at all: roughly a third of every attempt would silently produce zero events regardless of the gate's own correctness. Spell 32247 ('Karazhan - Chess NPC Action: Melee Attack: DAMAGE (Footman)', coa-dbc-viewer record) is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, SchoolMask Normal/physical, EffectBasePoints 999 EffectDieSides 1 (a flat 1000), DmgClass NONE and carries SPELL_ATTR3_ALWAYS_HIT, so it neither scales with the striker's own weapon/level nor can miss/be dodged/parried/blocked -- a deterministic, always-landing 1000 physical damage hit, 150 of which (15%) never truncates to 0. A first attempt at an earlier candidate (18944 Smash, a DmgClass RANGED weapon-percent ability with an ordinary spell-hit roll) measured 1/1/2 on one gameplay run and 1/1/1 on an otherwise-identical second run (round10/judging-work/step10/diag1 vs run1, stamp 20261110-023934 vs 20261110-024059): the counter-strike's own trigger_count side is a stochastic miss on that spell, not a gate or margin defect, so it was replaced rather than padded with a wider reopen margin or a retry loop. 32247 is cast directly by the striker creature (CoAGameplayTest.cpp's non-player `cast` action uses Creature::CastSpell with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK, which does not require the striker's own spellbook to know it). icd_gate_scenario's new trigger_actor=striker path casts it at the caster from the fixtured striker (entry 36, reaction 0, stationary) instead of the caster casting trigger_spell at a target, reusing the existing three-attempt (short gap/reopen gap/drain) gate shape unchanged; this also proves the clause's own trigger_count side (the counter-strike 707720 must fire at all) in the same run, since a zero-event reading between the second and third attempt would read alert either way.

behaviours.name: Serendipity group stack cap
behaviours.quote: Does not stack with similar effects.
behaviours.observe_source: data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260922_27_raid_damage_percent_group.sql spell_group 2000184, stack_rule 3 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_SAME_EFFECT) lists 300929 alongside 300944/300961/300963/503738/520371/560528/560534/560545, all SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) at effect index 0, Effect=65 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID), EffectMiscValue[0]=127 (all schools); this is the area-aura effect SpellMgr::IsEffectInSameEffectStackGroup admits into the group (SpellMgr.cpp:814-819). 300929 EffectBasePoints[0]=2 (3%), 300944 EffectBasePoints[0]=2 (3%, confirmed via DBC); 300929's other effect (index 1, spell-cost reduction, a different stat) does not touch melee_damage_done. Stock Unit::GetHighestExclusiveSameEffectSpellGroupValue (Unit.cpp:5297-5320) caps same-group same-effect auras at the single highest magnitude rather than summing them; no CoA script overrides this for either spell. The metric is spell_damage_done against Fireball (133, Fire school, SchoolMask 4), not melee_damage_done: Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:11470) explicitly skips GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE) whenever the queried damageSchoolMask includes SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL ('mods for SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL are already factored in base melee damage calculation', a different code path this synthetic base-1000 query never reaches), so a melee_damage_done read against this aura always comes back unchanged regardless of whether the server is conformant -- confirmed by an exploratory run with melee_damage_done that measured baseline==own==combined even after the area-aura wait below, which this change replaced with a Fire-school spell_damage_done read that does take the GetTotalAuraMultiplier branch. Verified via two independent gameplay runs of conformance-templar-behaviour-300929: spell_damage_done against a dummy with spell 133 (base 1000) read baseline, then (after a 300 ms wait for the area aura's own Aura::UpdateOwner target-map rescan, SpellAuras.cpp, to reach the caster) after learning 300929 alone, then after additionally learning 300944 (a Death Knight talent, learned onto the Templar fixture purely as test harness setup via the 'learn' action's unconditional player->learnSpell, not a production change); the combined reading matched the 3% single-effect cap, not a summed 6%, in both runs.

behaviours.name: Call of the Monastery group stack cap
behaviours.quote: Does not stack with similar effects.
behaviours.observe_source: data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260908_05_guardian_completion.sql spell_group 2000180, stack_rule 3 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_SAME_EFFECT) lists 560550 alongside 19506/30802/53137/300871/524854/560001/560531/560593/704994/706633/712367/804730, all SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_PCT (166). 560550 effect index 0 is Effect=65 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID), EffectBasePoints[0]=4 (5%, party AP%, confirmed via DBC), the area-aura effect subject to the group cap (SpellMgr::IsEffectInSameEffectStackGroup only admits a CoA raid-group spell's area-aura effects, per its own 'must not swallow a talent's separate personal effect' comment, SpellMgr.cpp:814-819). 560550 effect index 2 is Effect=6 (plain SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA, not an area aura), EffectBasePoints[2]=4 (5%, 'in addition, increases your own attack power'), so it is never a member of group 2000180 and always applies in full regardless of any other group member. 30802 (Unleashed Rage, a Death Knight talent) effect index 1 is the matching area-aura effect, EffectBasePoints[1]=3 (4%, confirmed via DBC), strictly weaker than 560550's own 5% area effect. Stock Unit::GetHighestExclusiveSameEffectSpellGroupValue caps same-group same-effect auras at the single highest magnitude; no CoA script overrides this for either spell. Verified via two independent gameplay runs of conformance-templar-behaviour-560550: attack_power read baseline, then (after a 300 ms wait for the area aura's own Aura::UpdateOwner target-map rescan, SpellAuras.cpp, to reach the caster) after learning 560550 alone (area +5% times personal +5%, compounding to ~10.25%), then after additionally learning 30802 (learned onto the Templar fixture purely as test harness setup via the 'learn' action, not a production change); the combined reading stayed at the stronger area 5% (still times the personal 5%), not a summed area 9%, in both runs.

behaviours.name: Fortified Body group stack cap
behaviours.quote: Does not stack with similar effects.
behaviours.observe_source: 300515's own effect index 0 is Effect=65 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID), EffectApplyAuraName[0]=118 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT), EffectBasePoints[0]=5 (6%, confirmed via DBC, records.single_value(300515,0)==6.0); its effect index 1 (EffectApplyAuraName[1]=133, SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT, the separate 'increases your maximum health' clause, not this one) is unrelated. Unlike 300929/560550, no spell_group row anywhere in data/sql mentions 300515 (grepped every pending/base/update SQL file this session read); the non-stacking mechanism here is not SpellMgr's group system at all: Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken (Unit.cpp:10880-10895) computes the healing-taken bonus from GetMaxNegativeAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT) (debuffs) and GetMaxPositiveAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT) (buffs) unconditionally -- Unit::GetMaxPositiveAuraModifier (Unit.cpp:7091-7135) takes the single highest-magnitude aura of that type across every aura the unit holds, with no spell_group predicate and no per-class restriction, so any two sources of this aura type anywhere already cap rather than sum, by construction of the aura-handler itself (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:188, HandleNoImmediateEffect, 'implemented in Unit::SpellHealingBonus'); no CoA script overrides this. Partner 34123 (Tree of Life, a Druid talent, learned onto the Templar fixture purely as test harness setup via the 'learn' action, not a production change) carries the identical aura type at effect index 0, EffectBasePoints[0]=5 (6%, confirmed via DBC, records.single_value(34123,0)==6.0, equal to 300515's own 6% so an additive-stacking bug cannot hide behind a 'still capped by the larger one' coincidence). The metric reads spell_healing_taken (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3519-3524, Unit::SpellHealingBonusTaken(caster, info, 1000, HEAL), a synthetic base-1000 query, same idiom as Serendipity's spell_damage_done) on the caster itself (both the buff holder and the nominal heal target, so 'target':'caster' resolves the heal-source argument to the same fixture; this argument only matters for the unrelated Nature's Call family-37/707807 exception) against spell 578276 (Benediction, a real Templar heal spell, chosen only so SpellInfo::GetSchoolMask() etc. resolve; no actual cast happens). Verified via two independent gameplay runs of conformance-templar-behaviour-300515: spell_healing_taken read baseline 1000, then (after a 300 ms wait for the area aura's own Aura::UpdateOwner target-map rescan, SpellAuras.cpp, to reach the caster) after learning 300515 alone (1060, matching the 6% cap), then after additionally learning 34123 (stayed at 1060, not a summed 1120), in both runs.

behaviours.name: Righteous Custodian single target limit
behaviours.quote: Can only be placed on 1 target at a time.
behaviours.observe_source: Spell.dbc AttributesEx5 for 572808 is 0x20 (SPELL_ATTR5_LIMIT_N, 'Single-target aura: remove previous application to another unit if applied', SharedDefines.h:647); SpellInfo::IsSingleTarget (SpellInfo.cpp:1683-1689) returns true for this flag alone. Unit::AddAura (Unit.cpp:5440-5456) marks a newly applied single-target aura with SetIsSingleTarget and pushes it onto the caster's own GetSingleCastAuras() list, then (Unit.cpp:6072-6089) removes any other aura already on that list whose IsSingleTargetWith() matches, regardless of which unit holds it -- a stock engine mechanism, with no CoA script implementing or overriding it for 572808 (grep of src/server/coa/ for 572808 finds only its class-list registration in AscensionCustomClassData.h and this file's own entries; the harness's existing hit_notes entry for 572808 already establishes it carries no other custom scripting). This is an audit gap in the harness's measurement vocabulary (no scenario kind read a single-target aura's presence across two different recipients before this entry), not a server defect: the clause is already enforced by the DBC attribute alone.

behaviours.name: Transcending Strikes (Blade of Faith gate)
behaviours.quote: when used on enemies affected by Blade of Faith
behaviours.observe_source: Same AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp:327-333 block as the entry above, but isolating the other half of its AND condition: player->HasAura(804897) is learned once at the very start and stays known through both phases of this entry (setup_only_after), while the target's Blade of Faith 803872 aura is withheld in the first phase and applied (via setup_casts, cast on the dummy by the caster) only in the second. A short 50ms wait_ms (not the 3000ms default) keeps the cast-to-read window small; the aura's own live decrement (Aura::Update's per-tick countdown, unlike cooldown_ms's absolute-endtime subtraction) still carries a few ms of simulated-clock tick jitter across separate exploratory runs even at this short window (two runs read 5944/7941 and 5944/7938, a 3ms spread on the after reading only), so this entry carries an explicit 10ms tolerance -- two orders of magnitude below the 2000ms clause this check exists to catch -- while every other metric_delta entry in this file keeps the tight default float tolerance. before_expected 5944 (6000-50-6ms) and expected 7940 (8000-50-10ms, the midpoint of the two observed after readings) are both read from .cache/verify-all/20261110-000604 and -000646 (apps/coa-gameplay-test/conformance/.cache/conformance/fvs-patience/scenarios/conformance-templar-behaviour-712678.json).

behaviours.name: Testament of Fortitude
behaviours.quote: Each second you will also remove 1 disease effect from yourself.
behaviours.observe_source: 500678 Effect[0] aura 227 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, EffectAmplitude[0] 1000 ms, EffectTriggerSpell[0] 500690 Ascetic Abdication, whose Effect[2] is SPELL_EFFECT_DISPEL (38) with EffectMiscValue[2] 3 (DISPEL_DISEASE) and EffectBasePoints[2] 0 (one dispel per tick). Fixtures: Frost Fever 55095 and Blood Plague 55078, both Dispel 3 with DurationIndex 8 (15000 ms), so neither expires inside the 2200 ms windows. Control arm: both diseases stay 2200 ms without the spell. With it: both present 800 ms after the cast (no tick yet, AttributesEx5 without SPELL_ATTR5_START_PERIODIC_AT_APPLY), one 1200 ms after, none 2200 ms after. The removal order between the two diseases is not fixed, so each reading sums them. 500678 is a channel (AttributesEx 4) that drains ManaPerSecond 15 Energy on top of its ManaCost 15, so the cast starts at 100 Energy (15 + 3 x 15 = 60 used in the window; regeneration on); at exactly 15 Energy the channel ended at the first tick (triage 2026-11-11, diagnostic runs 20261111-111303 and -112320). The previous entry waited 15200 ms, past Frost Fever's own 15000 ms duration, so its 1 to 0 also matched a natural expiry.

behaviours.name: Harmonic Disposition
behaviours.quote: and granting the ability to walk on water.
behaviours.reason: 560653 EffectImplicitTargetA[1]=1 (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER), Effect[1]=65 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID), EffectApplyAuraName[1]=104 (SPELL_AURA_WATER_WALK, Unit::HasWaterWalkAura/SpellAuraDefines.h:167), EffectRadiusIndex[1]=23 (SpellRadius.dbc id 23, 40 yd); an AREA_AURA_RAID effect is carried by the caster and the server's own area-aura update re-applies its aura to every nearby raid/party member within radius, so a grouped ally (player_fixture spawns co-located with the caster, well inside 40 yd) must gain the water_walk aura once the caster has it, not only the caster itself. Range.dbc id 1 is Self Only, so the cast targets the caster; the party grouping (the 'group' action) is what puts the second player fixture in range of the area-aura system, matching the tooltip's own 'nearby party and raid members' clause this spell's Description opens with.

behaviours.name: Interdict
behaviours.quote: If they are an Undead or Demon they are unable to be healed for the duration.
behaviours.reason: 560116 Effect[0]=6 (SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA, SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE) plus Effect[1]=64 (SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell[1]=561309 'Atone for your Sins!'); 561309's own Effect[0]=6 applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT EffectBasePoints -101 unconditionally (Spell::EffectTriggerSpell at SpellEffects.cpp has no per-spell creature-type gate for any trigger spell, confirmed by reading the function and grepping src/server/coa for 560116/561309, both absent before this round's fix), over-applying the heal block to every target regardless of type -- a Templar server defect now fixed in AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp's OnSpellCalculatedTarget (templar_casts), which sets hit.missCondition = SPELL_MISS_IMMUNE for the 561309 trigger cast when the target's GetCreatureType() is neither CREATURE_TYPE_UNDEAD nor CREATURE_TYPE_DEMON, suppressing the heal-block aura on non-Undead/Demon targets while leaving it intact on Undead/Demon ones. Creature entry 201 (Brittlebones Skeleton, creature_template.type=6 Undead) proves the block holds on Undead: 561309 is measured present (aura metric) on the target after the cast. A creature self-cast of a direct heal spell was tried first as the measurement and found unreliable in this harness independent of Interdict (a bare self-heal cast by an owned TempSummon never actually applies, with no error reported, for a reason this round did not chase further since the aura-presence measurement sidesteps it entirely and is the more precise, more direct signal of the mechanism anyway).

behaviours.name: Testament of Strength
behaviours.quote: Applies Sacred Restraint for
behaviours.observe_source: server defect found and fixed this item: AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp OnSpellCast previously cast 102208 (Sacred Restraint) only on casting Testament of Faith (801478), Testament of Will (801455) or Testament of Hope (1397742), never on Testament of Strength (300514) itself, despite 300514's own tooltip ('Your next 3 Titanstrikes...Lasts $d. Applies Sacred Restraint for $102208d.') carrying the identical clause its three siblings already apply on their own cast. 300514's own effects (108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER cooldown%, 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER damage%, 262 ABILITY_IGNORE_AURASTATE, coa-dbc-viewer Spell 300514) have no EffectTriggerSpell to 102208 either, and grep -rn 102208 src/server/coa/ found only that one OnSpellCast line before the fix, so no other path applied it; Titanstrike itself (806521, citation templar.json:66-67) is not in that condition at all (EffectTriggerSpell[1]=707896, coa-dbc-viewer Spell 806521), so a cast of Titanstrike under the 300514 buff was not an alternative path either, ruling out the 'next 3 Titanstrikes' sentence as the vehicle for this clause. Fix: added '|| info->Id == 300514' to both the outer Named()-chain and the inner 'target ||' guard (300514's effects are all EffectImplicitTargetA 1 TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, giving spell->m_targets.GetUnitTarget() no explicit unit target, the same reason 1397742 already carries that second bypass), so casting 300514 now casts 102208 on the caster, matching Will/Hope/Faith. Owner ruling (round5/round9 owner-rulings): a two-reading tooltip is settled from the Ascension logs, production runs our code, never ask players; coa-log-history's player_fights table has no per-ability cast or aura data at all (only aggregate damage/healing/deaths), so the logs are silent here, and this fix applies the one reading the tooltip supports (its own cast applies the named aura, exactly as its three siblings already do), which is a server defect under the owner's 'a new check that shows the server breaks the tooltip is a server defect' rule, not an ambiguity.

behaviours.name: Righteous Custodian
behaviours.quote: reducing their total threat by
behaviours.observe_source: coa-dbc-viewer Spell 572808: Effect[0]=6 SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AURA, EffectApplyAuraName[0]=227 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, EffectAmplitude[0]=1000 ms, EffectTriggerSpell[0]=572809, EffectBasePoints[0]=-3/EffectDieSides[0]=1 (CalcValue -2, matching the already-verified $572809s1 token). AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellWithValueAuraTick (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:6547-6568) casts 572809 from the aura holder, passing GetAmount() (-2) as the triggered spell's own SPELLVALUE_BASE_POINT0 override, so 572809's own raw EffectBasePoints is never what actually applies. 572809's Effect[0]=125 SPELL_EFFECT_MODIFY_THREAT_PERCENT, EffectImplicitTargetA[0]=22 TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TargetB[0]=16 TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex[0]=12 (SpellRadius.dbc RadiusMin 100 yards, far more than the fixture's 3-yard distance); Spell::EffectModifyThreatPercent (SpellEffects.cpp:6459-6467) calls 'unitTarget->GetThreatMgr().ModifyThreatByPercent(m_caster, damage)' on every enemy the AoE finds around the aura holder, and ThreatManager::ModifyThreatByPercent (ThreatManager.h:150) does 'ScaleThreat(target, 0.01f * float(100 + percent))', a pure float multiply with no rounding, giving an exact 0.98 ratio regardless of the dummy's actual (RNG-built) threat level. The caster first attacks the dummy to build a real, non-deterministic threat baseline (ThreatManager has no direct set action), then casts 572808 on itself (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_RAID 57, the caster is a raid member of itself, as the cast_applies_aura entry), so the aura holder whose threat the ticks scale is the caster; its aura_duration_ms is read 0 before the cast and above 0 after it (rule 4 amendment point 2b, a real application, audit 2026-11-12). The threat baseline is read after the cast, since Spell::HandleThreatSpells (Spell.cpp:5711-5751) forwards the positive cast's SpellLevel 40 threat to the dummy, and the check reads a ratio rather than an absolute before/after value.

behaviours.name: Norgannon's Wrath
behaviours.quote: Damage dealt pierces all immunities, resistances, and damage absorption effects.
behaviours.observe_source: Blessed Resilience 33143 (Effect[0] aura 197 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE, EffectBasePoints[0] -1001) is set on the dummy before each cast, so neither cast can crit: a crit of one cast (2182 = 1.5 x 1455, counted runs 20261111-223346 and -223442) read 1.5 against 1 without it. AscensionTemplarContracts.cpp (around line 265): 'if (id == 524740 && info->Effects[1].TriggerSpell == 520842 && info->Effects[0].TargetB.GetTarget() == TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY) { info->AscensionIgnoreAbsorbAndResistance = true; ... }', setting a custom SpellInfo flag on 524740, the Holy damage spell 524739's own effects trigger (round5 investigation, templar.json:204-205). Unit::CalcAbsorbResist (Unit.cpp, around line 2662) starts with 'if (spellInfo && spellInfo->AscensionIgnoreAbsorbAndResistance) return;', before either the magic partial-resist roll or the SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB consumption loop later in that same function, so both are skipped entirely for 524740's hits; coa-dbc-viewer confirms AscensionIgnoreAbsorbAndResistance has no DBC-field counterpart, it is this fork's own SpellInfo member (SpellInfo.h:362). Immunity-piercing is separate and DBC-native: coa-dbc-viewer Spell 524740 Attributes=536870912 (SPELL_ATTR0_NO_IMMUNITIES) and AttributesEx2=67108864 (SPELL_ATTR2_NO_SCHOOL_IMMUNITIES). The scenario measures 524740's own cumulative spell_damage_total against the dummy once with no shield present and once more after 706583 (Staffguard, the Templar's own Holy-school SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB aura, reused from this same class file's shield_break_trigger entries) is set directly on the dummy, expecting an unchanged damage ratio (1.0) and an untouched shield aura_amount; a server that let the shield absorb part of the hit despite AscensionIgnoreAbsorbAndResistance would show up as both a reduced ratio and a drained shield.

behaviours.name: Righteous Custodian
behaviours.quote: reducing their total threat by
behaviours.observe_source: Recipient arm of the magnitude claim (review I1): "their" is the blessed party or raid member. The ally is grouped with the caster, the caster and the ally both build threat on the dummy by melee, and the caster casts 572808 on the ally (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_RAID 57, SpellInfo::CheckExplicitTarget accepts a group member). AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellWithValueAuraTick casts 572809 from the aura holder, and Spell::EffectModifyThreatPercent scales the dummy's threat toward that holder, so one tick in 1200 ms gives the dummy's threat toward the ally a ratio of 0.98.

behaviours.name: Keeping the Oath
behaviours.quote: You now delay 40% of direct damage taken, instead taking it over $803237d.
behaviours.observe_source: Keeping the Oath 92109 carries the stagger absorb (AscensionTemplarContracts.cpp:104-117 turns its Effect[0] into SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_ABSORB on all schools; AscensionTemplarAuras.cpp:21-29 absorbs uint64(damage) * 40 / 100 of a non-periodic hit from another unit and Delay()s it into Oathkeeper 803237, AscensionTemplar.cpp:182-198; each 1000 ms tick deals the remaining debt divided by the ticks left, AscensionTemplarAuras.cpp:164-174, logged as 803237 damage on the caster). A level 60 striker (entry 36) casts Light of the Naaru 41394 (1100 Holy) at the caster, held at 20000 health, once per trial. Control: no 92109, nothing absorbed. Treatment: 92109 set; every strike must absorb floor(40% of its damage), and the whole absorbed amount must be paid as 803237 damage, with the debt gone, 500 ms after the debt's 8000 ms end.

behaviours.name: Keeping the Oath
behaviours.quote: You now delay 40% of direct damage taken, instead taking it over $803237d.
behaviours.observe_source: As the delay entry, and the debt must also still be present with part of it unpaid 500 ms before its 8000 ms end ($803237d, Oathkeeper 803237 DurationIndex 31): the delayed damage is taken over the whole duration.

behaviours.name: Holy Books
behaviours.quote: Using a Libram now removes $707208s1% of the delayed damage from Oathkeeper.
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionTemplarAbilities.cpp:225-226 (OnSpellCast): a Libram cast with Holy Books 706468 known calls ReduceDebt(player, 70), which removes uint64(debt) * 70 / 100 of Oathkeeper 803237 (AscensionTemplar.cpp:199-211). Both arms carry Keeping the Oath 92109, take one Light of the Naaru 41394 strike (1100 Holy) from a level 60 striker (entry 36) at 20000 health, and cast Libram of Consecration 801441 300 ms later, before the debt's first tick; the treatment arm also carries 706468. The debt paid from the 803237 damage logs must be the whole absorbed amount without Holy Books and the absorbed amount less floor(70%%) with it, all paid by the debt's end.

A level 60 striker (entry 36, no owner: TempSummon::InitStats sets no owner GUID for a summon without properties) casts Void Zone 92559 (SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, Physical, EffectBasePoints 999, EffectDieSides 1, DmgClass none: no miss, no crit, no level scaling) at the caster; control without 801461, treatment with it set before every strike; the caster's armor is the same in both arms, so the damage ratio is the mitigation's.

A level 60 orc (race 2) Templar striker, PvP-flagged like the human caster, learns and casts Void Zone 92559 (1000 Physical, DmgClass none, no cooldown, no cost) at the caster; control without 801461, treatment with it set before every strike.

behaviours.observe_source: AscensionTemplarContracts.cpp:368-372 (ModifyPeriodicDamageAurasTick) multiplies a periodic damage tick taken by 1 + Light's Ward 301283 Effect[1] amount/100 (-15, EffectBasePoints -16) when its MiscValue (127) holds the tick's school and the spell carries SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE, _PERCENT or PERIODIC_LEECH; the stock aura 214 term of SpellDamageBonusTaken needs MiscValueB 1, which 301283 does not carry. 300529 grants 301283 through its Effect[0] (aura 23); the arm sets 301283 itself. A level 60 striker (entry 36) casts Void Zone 92559 (1000 Physical, DmgClass none) at the caster, then 1200 ms pass; each landed strike must return exactly floor(15% of its logged damage) as one 707720 hit on the striker, read from the damage logs the caster receives. behaviours.quote: increases your chance to resist disease effects by $s2%
behaviours.observe_source: 706323 Effect[1] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DEBUFF_RESISTANCE (178), MiscValue 3 (disease), EffectBasePoints 29 (+30); Unit::MagicSpellHitResult (Unit.cpp:4091-4092) adds its amount x 100 to the resist roll of a negative all-aura spell of that Dispel type, and only magic-class spells reach it (Unit::SpellHitResult sends melee and ranged classes to MeleeSpellHitResult, Unit.cpp:4166-4170). A level 60 striker (entry 36) casts Tetanus 8014 (Dispel 3 disease, DmgClass 1 magic, one SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT effect on the target) at the caster; each trial reads whether 8014 is on the caster 300 ms later and removes it. The control arm's resisted share is the same-level creature miss chance; the treatment arm must resist 30 points more often. 800 trials per arm in each of 28 pooled parts.

behaviours.name: Holy Constitution
behaviours.quote: Increases your damage dealt versus Undead by ${$m1+0}, scaling with level
behaviours.observe_source: AscensionTemplar code does not touch 706323 (not in TEMPLAR_TOOLTIP_UNSCALED_BY_LEVEL_SPELLS or _EFFECTS, so CancelStockEffectRealPointsPerLevel keeps its per-level term): Effect[0] is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_DONE_CREATURE (59), MiscValue 32 (Undead), EffectBasePoints 4 + EffectDieSides 1 plus EffectRealPointsPerLevel 1.5 from SpellLevel 28 to MaxLevel 60. MeleeDamageBonusDone (Unit.cpp:11415) adds it whole to a swing at an Undead victim, before the done multipliers; the spell path does not read aura 59. The caster at level 60 and Mindless Zombie 1501 (Undead) at level 60 swing for 60 main-hand intervals per arm; both arms carry Brute Force 54678 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -50000, physical), set before every swing, so the zombie's armor clamps to 0 (CalcArmorReducedDamage) and the flat bonus reaches the damage unscaled; the treatment arm also sets 706323. Non-critical, non-glancing hits only. Every damage the Templar deals to a creature is multiplied by its class tuning aura 887007 (Effect[0] aura 341, SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_PVE_DAMAGE_DONE_PCT, read -16 at level 50 and -20 at level 60; GetAscensionNormalTuningDamageMultiplier in MeleeDamageBonusDone), so the expected difference is the tooltip value times 1 + that amount, read in each arm.

behaviours.name: Crusader's Brand
behaviours.quote: While marked enemies can always be seen by the Crusader even while stealthed or invisible.
behaviours.observe_source: Same arms as the predicate entry, read as the server applies them: before each read the caster steps 3 yd aside and back, 1000 ms apart, so Map::PlayerRelocation queues NOTIFY_VISIBILITY_CHANGED and Unit::ExecuteDelayedUnitRelocationEvent (the move exceeds DynamicVisibility's 1 yd requiredMoveDistance) runs a PlayerRelocationNotifier; Player::UpdateVisibilityOf then adds or destroys the dummy with CanSeeOrDetect(target, false, true). nearby_creature_at_client reads Player::HaveAtClient, the client-visible set that decision leaves. A stationary dummy's aura change alone runs no update (ExecuteDelayedUnitRelocationEvent returns below that distance), hence the step.

The ally, grouped with the caster, melee-attacks a REACT_DEFENSIVE dummy for three swing intervals before Barrier of Light and again 3500 ms after it (past the first 3000 ms trigger); the dummy's threat on the ally and on the caster is read before and after each attack. The engine's arithmetic: 8 (SpellEffectInfo::CalcRadius) + 2.66 (Spell::SelectImplicitAreaTargets adds WorldObject::GetLeewayBonusRadius for TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY) + the dummy's combat reach (WorldObjectSpellAreaTargetCheck for a player-controlled caster and a SRC reference) against the target's exact distance, an edge near 11.935 yd.
